spec_provided_observability.name: IEEE 1500 test access port
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Wrapper-based test access through the base/logic die for boundary/interconnect test.

spec_provided_observability.name: Direct Access (DA) test
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Direct probing of the DRAM dies through the base die for KGSD screening.

spec_provided_observability.name: MBIST / loopback
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Self-test and data-bus loopback to characterize links at 6.4 Gb/s/pin.

spec_provided_observability.name: Link-ECC / on-die-ECC error counters
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Report corrected/uncorrectable error counts for RAS.

spec_provided_observability.name: CA parity alert (AERR/DERR)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Report command/address parity errors and severity.

spec_provided_observability.name: TEMP readout
spec_provided_observability.purpose: On-die temperature reported for refresh adaptation and thermal debug.

stacked_die_test_strategy: HBM3 test is hierarchical: each DRAM die is screened; the stack is tested as a known-good-stacked-die (KGSD) through the base die's IEEE-1500 / direct-access ports; the stack-on-interposer is tested for TSV / microbump integrity. TSMC produces the base die for HBM and is a foundry for HBM stacking.
notes: HBM3 places test/repair logic largely in the base/logic die so the DRAM dies stay dense. RAS reporting (link ECC, on-die ECC, CA parity, soft-repair) doubles as in-field debug observability.
